importador.description: Statements, card bills, invoices, loan contracts, consortium contracts, brokerage notes and whatever else the company has. The agent says what each one is, where each item belongs and what is already recorded. Nothing is saved without your approval.
importador.privacy.text: Our rules read them first, without AI. Only what they cannot understand goes to the AI service, outside Brazil, and only with your authorization: the text of the file, with CPF, CNPJ, e-mail and partner names replaced. A scanned file or photo goes as it is, with everything in it, including other people's data. Files stay stored in your company, and what is not approved is deleted after 30 days.
